deal.Text: Deal. Let's go break its teeth.

rejoin.Text: Fall in, Anvil. We're not done.

intro.Text: Name's Brock Malone. Folks call me Anvil, on account of what happens when things hit me. I used to run security on the old transit line, before the tunnels went bad. Something big has been nesting at the bottom of this hole, and I'm not walking out of here until it's dead.

job.Text: Abmouth Supremus. Big, ugly, all mouth, and it eats the scavengers who wander too deep. I can't take it alone, and from the look of you, neither can you. Bring it down with me and you'll be paid well, and I'll answer your call anywhere on Rubi-Ka after. Until then, I only fight down here.

deal.Text: Good. I'll take the hits, you do the damage. Kill Abmouth Supremus. {givequest MSUB}{dungeonmerc enforcer_subway}

active.Text: Abmouth is still breathing. That's a problem. I'm with you as long as we're in these tunnels.

done.Text: Never thought I'd see that thing dead. You've got my number now. Call me anywhere with /merc and I'll come running.
